text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from shopping with Tanino Gimlet,
we were caught in a sudden downpour.
choice_data_list: And I didn't even bring an umbrella...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly slipped under the eaves to take shelter from the rain.
However—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, why are you hiding under the roof?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having stepped out from under the eaves without anyone noticing, Tanino Gimlet calmly continued speaking while being pelted by the rain.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Such trivialities matter not!!
Not when my passion burns hotter than the freezing rain!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear the melody of the falling rain?
A shopping district that has forgotten its bustling noise...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"At this very moment—
this place has become our stage!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Now—enjoy the rain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She took my hand and led me out into the rain.
In no time at all, my clothes were soaked.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Don't get trapped by form—sync up with passion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dragged out as I was, I tried my best
to match Tanino Gimlet's movements, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in, my movements gradually grew bolder.
Stepping into puddles over and over, my feet were an absolute mess.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel the weight of soaked clothes or the chill of rain.
Only this very moment—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing the sound of applause snapped me back to reality.
The rain had stopped before I even noticed."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
—Yo! Looking good, ladies!
—That was a truly wonderful dance.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Only by utilizing the entire stage
can one receive Hathor's blessing."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have acquired a new fruit of wisdom.
You have my thanks, my people. And now—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Consider yourself fortunate to have witnessed our fleeting dance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The applause shows no sign of stopping, and Tanino Gimlet is in high spirits, but—
choice_data_list: It's bad for my heart, so please go easy on stuff like this...
It's a shame the rain stopped.
It's a shame the rain stopped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The applause shows no sign of stopping, and Tanino Gimlet is in high spirits, but—
choice_data_list: It's bad for my heart, so please go easy on stuff like this...
It's a shame the rain stopped.
It's a shame the rain stopped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If spontaneous dance sessions keep happening like this,
my heart won't be able to take it!
Saying that, I handed her a towel, and—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What's this? My dance partner is waking from her dream quite early.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, let loose once in a while.
If we don't enjoy ourselves,
the audience won't be able to smile either.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...
This holds true even for a resplendent victory banquet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, dancing in the rain was fun... Above all, seeing Tanino Gimlet so full of life was truly heartwarming."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entertaining the audience by enjoying it yourself...
I felt like I had caught a glimpse of her philosophy regarding live performances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because it was so fun, it felt like it ended in an instant.
I caught myself wishing this moment would last forever.
Handing her a towel as I said this—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, same here...
It was quite an entertaining time.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet, it is precisely because it passes in the blink of an eye
that it shines so brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent victory banquet is the same...
The audience is captivated by that fleeting brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I caught a glimpse of what lives mean to her.
That was one brief scene on a rainy day.
